sources.description: Checked for contractor and supplier responsibilities: fair safeguarding, clear contract documents, correction of errors, rejection of nonconforming work, payment certificates, technical information, technical services, gifts, commissions, favors, moral obligation, reciprocal frame of mind, and client-credited market discounts.
